label: Matt 24:1
text: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

label: Matt 24:2
text:
But he answered them,
“You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

label: Matt 24:3
text: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

label: Matt 24:5
text: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

label: Matt 24:6
text: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

label: Matt 24:7
text: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

label: Matt 24:9
text: Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

label: Matt 24:11
text: Many false prophets will arise, and will lead many astray.

label: Matt 24:15
text:
“When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation,

which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

label: Matt 24:16
text: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

label: Matt 24:21
text: for then there will be great oppression, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

label: Matt 24:23
text: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ,’ or, ‘There,’ don’t believe it.

label: Matt 24:26
text: If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

label: Matt 24:29
text: But immediately after the oppression of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

label: Matt 24:30
text: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

label: Matt 24:32
text: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable. When its branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

label: Matt 24:33
text: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

label: Matt 24:36
text:
But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven,
but my Father only.

variants.reading: with 'nor the Son': 'But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, nor the Son, but my Father only'
variants.note: The fetched Wikipedia article 'Knowledge of Christ' states that while Mark 13:32 includes the words, 'in most manuscripts Matthew 24:36 does not include the words neither the Son'. The attribution of the longer reading to Sinaiticus and Vaticanus follows the architect calibration (they carry the Alexandrian text of the verse); a direct page stating their exact reading could not be fetched (codexsinaiticus.org unreachable after three attempts) - see notes.md, Uncertain.

label: Matt 24:41
text: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

label: Matt 24:43
text: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

label: The Temple buildings were thrown down, so that not one stone was left on another
statement: The Temple buildings were thrown down, so that not one stone was left on another - predicted in the discourse (24:2); the Temple buildings were destroyed and razed in 70 CE. The claim is scoped to the Temple buildings: the platform's retaining walls survive.

label: Men claiming to be the messiah or a prophet ('I am the Christ'; false christs and false prophets) arose and led followers astray in Judea
statement: Men claiming to be the messiah or a prophet ('I am the Christ'; false christs and false prophets) arose and led followers astray in Judea - predicted in 24:5, 11, 23-26.

label: Wars and rumors of wars, famines, plagues and earthquakes in various places afflicted the period
statement: Wars and rumors of wars, famines, plagues and earthquakes in various places afflicted the period - predicted in 24:6-7.

label: The disciples were delivered up to oppression and killed, hated by all the nations for Jesus' name's sake
statement: The disciples were delivered up to oppression and killed, hated by all the nations for Jesus' name's sake - predicted in 24:9.

label: The abomination of desolation, spoken of through Daniel the prophet, stood in the holy place
statement: The abomination of desolation, spoken of through Daniel the prophet, stood in the holy place - predicted in 24:15 (the desolating sacrilege set up in the Temple).

label: When the desolation appeared, those in Judea fled to the mountains
statement: When the desolation appeared, those in Judea fled to the mountains - predicted as a command in 24:16-20.

label: Signs appeared in the heavens
statement: Signs appeared in the heavens - the sun darkened, the moon without light, stars falling - and the sign of the Son of Man was seen coming on the clouds of the sky - predicted in 24:29-30.

label: The fig tree's branch becoming tender and producing leaves is the sign that summer is near
statement: The fig tree's branch becoming tender and producing leaves is the sign that summer is near - a custom of reading the seasons from the fig tree, taught as a parable in 24:32-33.

label: Two women ground grain at a hand-mill, one taken and one left
statement: Two women ground grain at a hand-mill, one taken and one left - the domestic grinding custom named in 24:41.

label: A householder who knew in what watch of the night the thief was coming would have watched
statement: A householder who knew in what watch of the night the thief was coming would have watched - the night-watch custom named in 24:43.
